title: 1 · Package Managers
text:
We strongly recommend installing all tooling through a package manager — it keeps dependencies repeatable and easy to upgrade.


Homebrew installs under /opt/homebrew (Apple Silicon) or /usr/local (Intel).
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
echo 'eval "$(/opt/homebrew/bin/brew shellenv)"' >> ~/.zprofile   # Apple Silicon
brew doctor          # Verify install


brew update          # refresh formulas
brew upgrade         # upgrade all packages




Chocolatey installs to C:\ProgramData\chocolatey.
Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force
[System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = 3072
iex ((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))
choco upgrade chocolatey

Why not Winget?
Chocolatey covers everything we need and works on Server 2022 machines used in CI.








Next Step



Head to Git & Clone to install Git and pull the codebase.

title: Welcome
text:
Pedalogical Developer On‑Ramp 🚀
Welcome to the Pedalogical Developer Docs — your single source of truth for getting a local development environment up and running in less than 30 minutes (coffee not included ☕).
Whether you are:

Totally new to the project and need everything installed,

Migrating from our former SQL Server stack, or

Returning after a hiatus and just need a refresher,

start at the top‑left sidebar and work downward. Every page ends with a Next Step link so you can cruise hands‑free.

Pro Tip
Keep a terminal open next to these docs and copy‑paste as you go. Most commands are idempotent — if you run them twice nothing breaks.

If you hit a snag jump to Troubleshooting at the bottom of each page or post in the #dev‑help Discord channel.

title: 2 · Git & Clone
text:
Platform
Install
Verify




macOS
brew install git
git --version


Windows
choco install git -y
git --version




If macOS prompts for Xcode Command‑Line Tools, accept the install — Homebrew relies on them.




ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@willamette.edu"
pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub   # macOS
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub        # Windows Git Bash
Add the key to your GitHub account (Settings → SSH Keys).



We keep all project repos in ~/GitHub for consistency.
cd ~
mkdir -p GitHub && cd GitHub
git clone git@github.com:wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git   # SSH
# or
git clone https://github.com/wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git  # HTTPS
cd AiTutor
git status


git remote add upstream https://github.com/wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git
git pull upstream main







Next Step



Configure your Environment Variables.

title: 5 · Database Setup
text:
Pedalogical uses PostgreSQL 17. Pick one of the two methods below.





brew install postgresql@17
brew services start postgresql@17          # auto‑starts at login
Default data directory ➜ /opt/homebrew/var/postgresql@17



choco install postgresql17 -y
# Accept installer prompts and set the superuser password
pgAdmin is offered in the EnterpriseDB installer, or install via Chocolatey:
choco install pgadmin4 -y










macOS
Windows




brew install --cask docker
choco install docker-desktop -y



Launch Docker Desktop once to finish post‑install steps.






macOS
Windows




brew install --cask pgadmin4
choco install pgadmin4 -y






cd ~/GitHub/AiTutor/Docker
cp docker-compose.example.yml docker-compose.yml
Edit docker-compose.yml:
environment:
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: "yourStrongPassword"



docker-compose up -d
docker ps           # verify 'pedalogical-db' is healthy
Ports (default):



Service
Host Port




Postgres
5433


pgAdmin
8080








Open http://localhost:8080
Add new server:
Host : host.docker.internal (mac/Win)
Port: 5433








Tip



Which method should I pick?
Docker is disposable, reproducible, and keeps your host clean.
Native is fine if you prefer brew services or need DB access when Docker isn’t running.









Next Step



Run EF Core Migrations.

title: 6 · Entity Framework Migrations
text:
Entity Framework Core keeps the Postgres schema in sync with your C# models.


Run once per environment:
dotnet ef database update --project src/Pedalogical.Data



dotnet ef migrations add <Feature>_<DateUTC>   --project src/Pedalogical.Data   --startup-project src/Pedalogical.Api
dotnet ef database update --project src/Pedalogical.Data


<Verb><Entity><WhatChanged>_<yyyymmddHHMM>
Examples:

AddStudentEmail_202507052130
RenameCourseTable_20250710





dotnet ef migrations remove --project src/Pedalogical.Data



dotnet ef database update 202507052130 --project src/Pedalogical.Data



dropdb pedalogical           # native
createdb pedalogical
dotnet ef database update










Issue
Fix




Build failed
Ensure the solution builds before running dotnet ef.


No migrations were applied
You already ran them — verify with select * from __EFMigrationsHistory;.




🎉 You now have a fully functioning Pedalogical dev environment!

title: 4 · . NET Development Environment
text:
We target .NET 9 LTS (preview until GA) and use Entity Framework Core 9 for data access.





Platform
Command




macOS
brew install --cask dotnet-sdk


Windows
choco install dotnet-9.0-sdk -y



Verify:
dotnet --version   # 9.x.x



dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef
# add to PATH on macOS
echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.dotnet/tools:$PATH"' >> ~/.zprofile






macOS
Windows




brew install --cask visual-studio-code
choco install vscode -y



From VS Code Command Palette run:
Shell Command: Install 'code' command in PATH


code --install-extension ms-dotnettools.csdevkit
code --install-extension ms-dotnettools.csharp
code --install-extension jmrog.vscode-nuget-package-manager
code --install-extension ms-azuretools.vscode-docker
code --install-extension EditorConfig.EditorConfig







Next Step



Choose your preferred Database Setup path.

title: 3 · Environment Variables
text:
The application loads configuration from a dotenv file so secrets never reach source control.


cd ~/GitHub/AiTutor
cp .env.example .env











Key
Description
Where to Find




POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Password for local/Docker Postgres superuser
Choose your own


OPENAI_API_KEY
Needed for AI features
Notion → Secrets


AZURE_STORAGE_KEY
Media uploads
Notion → Secrets



Open .env in your editor:
code .env
Any value left blank will cause the app to fail fast with a descriptive error.



Values are read at application startup. Restart the dev server after edits.







Next Step



Install .NET Tooling.
